title: Minimum Window Subsequence
description: Find the minimum contiguous substring of S which contains T as a subsequence.
pseudocode:
1. sIdx = 0, tIdx = 0, minLen = Infinity, res = ''
2. while sIdx < S.length:
3.   if S[sIdx] == T[tIdx]:
4.     tIdx++
5.   if tIdx == T.length:
6.     right = sIdx, tIdx = tIdx - 1
7.     while tIdx >= 0:
8.       if S[sIdx] == T[tIdx]: tIdx--
9.       sIdx--
10.    sIdx++, tIdx++
11.    if right - sIdx + 1 < minLen:
12.      minLen = right - sIdx + 1, res = S.slice(sIdx, right + 1)
13.  sIdx++

steps.note: Found 'b' at index 1, moving tIdx to 1.
Found 'c' at index 2, tIdx becomes 2 (length of T).
Backtracking to find the start of the window from index 2.
